capabilities.description: Beekeepers can register and list apiaries and hives. Only the owner is allowed to register a hive, and hives can be queried along with their status.
capabilities.name: Apiary and hive registry

capabilities.description: Hive inspections are recorded and checked. A hive is flagged as needing varroa treatment when an inspection goes over the threshold, and it stays flagged until a treatment is recorded and a later inspection is back under the threshold.
capabilities.name: Hive inspection and varroa monitoring

capabilities.description: Manages the catalogue of treatment products, records treatments given to hives and records honey harvests. A harvest is refused while a treatment's withdrawal period is still running. The treatment and harvest history of each hive can be looked up.
capabilities.name: Hive treatment and honey harvest tracking

capabilities.description: Hive scales are linked to hives. Swarms are detected from the scale data, and the beekeeper gets a delayed SMS alert. The alert is cancelled if an inspection recorded in the meantime explains the event.
capabilities.name: Swarm detection and SMS alerting from connected scales

capabilities.description: Builds quarterly reports for each region, with hive counts, varroa-flagged hives and honey harvest totals. It relies on the hive status from the hive service.
capabilities.name: Quarterly regional beekeeping reporting
